name: Ekko
notes: Opens by attacking immediately and casting Chronobreak (R) at t = 0 purely for its explosion damage; its heal and stasis do not matter to damage dealt and are ignored, and it is recast on cooldown afterward.

Timewinder (Q) is cast on cooldown: the outgoing hit lands on cast, and the return hit is scheduled Timewinder's stated 1.75 s expand duration later, used as a stand-in for the grenade's full out-and-back travel time since exact travel distance to a stationary dummy is not modeled.

Phase Dive (E) is woven in right after an attack once it is off cooldown: it resets Ekko's attack timer, so the very next attack becomes the empowered one with its own fixed 0.25 s cast time carrying its bonus damage, and its cooldown starts when that attack lands (post-effect).

Z-Drive Resonance (P) stacks from every basic attack (as an on-hit rider) and from every Q/E/R damage instance; the third stack consumes all three for bonus magic damage, after which a 4 s per-target lockout blocks new stacks, and stacks decay if 4 s pass without a hit landing (3 stacks, 4 s window, 4 s lockout, all stated directly in the wiki text even though the bin carries no dedicated fields for them).

Parallel Convergence (W) is never actively cast: its active only sets up a self-shield/stun with no direct damage against a stationary, non-chasing dummy, so only its passive on-hit bonus (3% + 3% per 100 AP of the target's missing health, only while the target is below 30% max health) fires, computed as an on-hit rider alongside every attack.

Because W's on-hit passive only triggers once the dummy's current health has been brought under 30% of its maximum, it can legitimately never fire within a short fight against a tankier build (see 'unused'); this is not a bug, it is the ability working as designed.
Chronobreak's cast-to-explosion delay is read as the wiki's stated 0.5 s (cast time and dash duration agree at 0.5 s in the prose) rather than the sheet's conflicting 0.25 s castTime field.
Z-Drive Resonance's 270% damage bonus against monsters does not apply, since the dummy counts as an enemy champion.
Mana costs are not modeled: nothing in Ekko's kit would realistically run him out of mana inside a 15 s fight at level 16.

assumed.why: used as the approximate total delay between Timewinder's outgoing and return damage instances, since exact travel distance to a stationary target is not modeled

unused.W: Parallel Convergence deals damage only through its passive on-hit bonus, gated to fire while the target is below 30% of its maximum health. Against a full-health stationary dummy with defensive itemization, an 8-15 s fight can end before Ekko's other damage (Q/E/R/P/autos) brings it under that threshold, so some item builds and durations legitimately show no W-labeled source in the breakdown even though the code applies it correctly whenever the threshold is crossed.
